description: A repair is findable and plausible, but the evidence does not justify applying it unsupervised. StateGuard must surface it on `RepairResult.ambiguous` and leave the payload alone. Silently applying is a false positive; silently dropping is worse than either, because the caller learns nothing.

cases.name: one_key_two_plausible_homes
cases.description: user_email is a strong lexical match for both user_id (0.891) and user_name (0.913). Higher raw similarity than the temp_celsius repair that must succeed -- only the margin separates them.

cases.name: contested_key_with_a_decoy_rename
cases.description: A second, unrelated rename in the same payload must not make the contested one look unopposed. The legitimate rename still applies; the contested one does not.

cases.name: contested_key_with_a_declared_default
cases.description: Filling the competing field from its default must not resolve the contest -- nothing was learned about where user_email belongs.

cases.name: three_fields_one_key
cases.description: Three near-equal homes is more ambiguous than two, not less.

cases.name: two_keys_one_field
cases.description: Competition from the other side: two unexpected keys equally close to one missing field.

cases.name: enum_members_collide_on_case
cases.description: A contract declaring both 'Done' and 'done' cannot say which was meant by 'DONE'.

cases.name: enum_members_collide_on_space
cases.description: 'in progress' and 'in_progress' normalise identically; the received value is equally close to both.

cases.name: enum_members_collide_on_separator_only
cases.description: Every candidate needs separator rewriting, so none is closer than the others. Still two options the caller should get to choose between.
cases.known_gap: Every candidate needs separator rewriting, so all tie at fidelity 0.85; 0.85 x the 0.70 tie factor = 0.595, just under INFERRED.reject_below (0.60). Both candidates are rejected rather than surfaced. Fixing it by moving the band would be fitting a threshold to a strategy written after it was set.

cases.name: normalized_name_collision
cases.description: A contract declaring both user_id and userId has two fields that normalise identically.

cases.name: near_tie_between_two_targets
cases.description: 'code' is one character from both 'codes' and 'coded'.
